resources.string: No app available to open this link. Email support@dotsuite.dev for help.
Delete your DotReminder account and its associated data
Continue to DotSuite to send a deletion request by email. Opening the page does not submit a request or delete anything.
Deletion covers your sign-in account, profile, reminders and their saved locations, categories, templates and session records.
After confirming account ownership, we process your request within 30 days. You can also request deletion after uninstalling the app.
Completed deletion is permanent. Until it is completed, existing reminders may still notify you. Review the page for local copies and service-provider retention details.
